title: Weekly leaderboard
text: See the top 10 learners this week. Opt in from your account to join; it resets every Monday.

title: Share your wins
text: Finish a day or hit a streak and get a card you can send to friends, with a QR code to join.

title: Hints, if you want them
text: Turn on optional hints in your account and get unstuck without spoiling the answer.

title: Review queue
text: Questions you struggled with come back after 1, 3, 7 and 21 days, so they stick.

title: Streak freezes
text: Earn a freeze every 7 practice days. A missed day will not wipe your streak.

title: Every question tested
text: All Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced coding questions are checked against hidden tests.
